title: Ethos Vapors Strawberry Crispy Treats 60ml/100ml
description:
Ethos Vapors Strawberry Crispy Treats
The latest limited edition flavor from
Ethos Vapors
, Ethos Strawberry Crispy Treats, is the perfect blend of the original Crispy Treat flavor infused with fresh, ripe strawberry bits. Experience the delectable taste of sweet rice cereal treats combined with the vibrant flavor of strawberries. This e-juice offers a sweet cereal bar treat in a vapor form that will keep you coming back for more. Indulge in the perfect blend of flavors and take your vaping experience to the next level with Ethos Strawberry Crispy Treats. Try it today and discover the unique and delightful taste of this limited edition e-juice.
